desc: Autoloading shotgun with Active Valve gas system operation. Synthetic stock in Woodland camouflage with textured grip surfaces. LPA front and rear ghost ring sights, Picatinny optics rail, Invector-Plus choke tubes. From running a 3-gun competition course to hunting turkey or just keeping handy when camping in the woods, the biggest feature of a Winchester SX4 Defender shotgun is versatility.
